Patient has a dog at home.
Patient works as an office manager.

Doctor advised the patient to continue taking Lemsip.
Doctor advised not to take other paracetamol-containing products with Lemsip.
Doctor advised cough syrup is not advisable during the daytime.
Doctor advised a small amount of cough syrup at night if unable to sleep.
Patient does not check blood sugar at home.
Doctor advised regular diabetes and blood pressure checkups.
